answer: The ledge schedule is applied in lantern and dawn reveals each instalment. A payout is split so that 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 2198 identities would post 585 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
